correctness.rationale: The vertex/pairwise graph-distance <=6 convention and inclusive scale are explicit. Adamaszek Corollary 6.7 at k/n=2/5 supplies the previously proved rank-two H4 concentration for C15^6. Signed augmented Lefschetz then gives chi(g)=-sum over setwise fixed faces (-1)^card(face) sign(g|face), including empty face. Recomputed every one of the 1364 faces and all 30 dihedral elements from the graph relation: f-vector augmented 1,15,90,275,450,378,140,15; five rotations r^(3b) trace 2, ten other rotations trace -1, all 15 reflections trace 0. These are exact finite exhaustive computations for the fixed 15-vertex object, not experiments extrapolated to arbitrary n. Finite-order trace 2 forces r^3 to act trivially on a two-dimensional rational vector space; quotient D3 character (2,-1,0) is standard irreducible, and rational finite-group invariant cohomology gives the claimed ordinary quotient rings. No integral or equivariant homotopy identification of quotients follows.
